title: At the byline
text: You've reached the goal line at a tight angle. A teammate is free in the middle.
tip: From the byline, look for a pull-back to the edge of the six-yard box. It's one of the most dangerous passes in football.

options.text: Pull it back to your teammate
options.why: Your teammate is facing goal with nobody on them. That's a much easier chance.

options.text: Cross it high to the far post
options.why: Nobody is there yet, so the ball may just go out.
The keeper is covering the near post, so there's almost nothing to aim at.
